records.semantics: append BE32(u32 at +0x8) to the std::string at +0x10; throw length_error when its length exceeds max_size - 4; no Mask/Unmask step

records.subject: FileChecksumGenCrc32c object
records.observation: Update (0x61cd1a0) reads/writes the u32 at +0x8 as the extend seed/result; the factory (0x61cd2e0) zeroes it and initialises the string at +0x10 with length 0 and SSO buffer at +0x20; the object is 0x30 bytes
the crc word is byte-swapped (bswap eax) and the 4 stack bytes are appended in memory order, so the appended bytes are big-endian; this is not the little-endian PutFixed32 used elsewhere in RocksDB

no rotate and no add of 0xa282ead8 occurs in the body; unlike ComputeBuiltinChecksum (0x616bca0, PR #5413), Finalize does not Mask or Unmask the accumulator -- the checksum string holds the raw CRC32C, byte-swapped only
throw length_error iff (max_size - len) <= 3; the append runs exactly when len <= max_size - 4

Update calls the registered extend once through the PLT stub at 0x61c25f0, which jumps through the .bss slot at 0x6508908; the initializer at 0x61c26d0 stores 0x61c21d0 there; Update is not in the vendor census, so its body hash is recorded from the binary only

records.note: each case cross-checked against an independent implementation (struct.pack big-endian vs manual byte-swap + bytearray extend); the binary itself was never executed
